answer_1.quote: In this work, we address these challenges of contextual commonsense knowledge generation by developing Diffusion COMmonsEnse Transformer models.
answer_1.outputs: commonsense inferences represented as triples (head, relation, tail)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate these methods on our clustering-based metrics described in Section 4... For ComFact, we also test on the metrics from  for evaluating commonsense knowledge generation, including BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We hire Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to evaluate the validity and contextual relevance of models' generated knowledge on the ROCStories portion of ComFact.
answer_4.guideline: Given a narrative context and a list of commonsense facts that a model generates about the context, we ask three workers to independently judge whether each fact is valid (i.e., plausible and natural-sounding) and relevant to the context, and take their majority vote as the assessment.
